candidates.context: Effective Date: 10/22/15, 7/26/17, 5/1/2020, 12/2/2022 Page 7 of 13 Typically, OPMA leads PLI/PAI inspections. OII typically leads surveillance inspections and OPQA III participates as specified on page 3 under OPQA III responsibilities.
